newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Citibank Australia yr profit A$160 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Citibank Australia yr profit A$160 mln.

text.p: Citicorp's Australian unit, Citibank Ltd, said on Tuesday its after tax operating profit rose 19 percent to A$160 million in calendar 1996.
Total operating revenue rose 14 percent to A$461 million while non-interest expenses rose five percent to A$256 million.

"In the consumer bank the strong performance from our insurance and investment business, as well as our credit card business, helped to offset the reduced margins experienced by our mortgage business, due to the increase in competition in the home loan market," Citibank Country Corporate Officer Tom McKeon said in the results statement.
A price war among Australian banks and their new non-bank competitors funded from securitisation has cut home loan margins in half to about 150 basis points over the last year.
Citibank Australia's Corporate Banking Managing Director Bill Ferguson said he was positive about the outlook for 1997.

The Citicorp group announced on January 21 its diluted earnings per share in the final quarter of 1996 were US$1.97, up from US$1.89 in 1995. This was up from analysts estimates of about US$1.95 and took full year net profit to US$3.631 billion from US$3.188 billion the previous year.
